calibration: Operational cost evidence only; never use these six units to select experiment 2.

experiment_1.hypothesis: Acceptance-adaptive k2/k4 may reduce drafting overhead while retaining useful accepted blocks.
experiment_1.rationale: Historical fixed-k2/k4 measurements favor n-grams; GRU overhead sometimes exceeds saved target work.
experiment_1.rule: Start k2 per request; promote after two consecutive fully accepted nonempty blocks; demote on any rejection.

fallback.rule: Keep adaptive promotion at two; after four nonempty proposal blocks, use cached greedy for the rest of the request if cumulative acceptance is below 0.5.

experiment_2.selection: Only after complete experiment-1 validation across the full manifest and both seeds. Compute median across cases of median paired greedy/adaptive-GRU time ratios per seed. If either seed is below 1 select fallback; otherwise strict.

strict.rule: Promote after four consecutive fully accepted nonempty blocks; demote on rejection.

test_freeze: Choose experiment 2 exclusively from complete validation, then freeze both policies before any full test evaluation.
